bugs.error_message: RealmSwitcher dropdown popover clipped behind or bled through by main viewport text (e.g. Atlas title and gesture hint bar)
bugs.root_cause: Sidebar and its header sat in a lower stacking context than the main viewport overlay elements, and the RealmSwitcher popover lacked an opaque backdrop/outside-click capture layer.
bugs.fix: Elevated Sidebar to relative z-[150] and its header to relative z-50, added fixed inset-0 z-[9990] dismiss backdrop to RealmSwitcher, and elevated the dropdown to z-[9995] with solid opaque background and deep drop shadow.

bugs.error_message: Top-right header corner bleed, aliased/jagged filigree corner borders, and duplicate 'Technological Groups' label for science category
bugs.root_cause: 1) Header sat inside scrollable content column with scrollbar gutter exposing cream parchment halo behind dark header. 2) VectorFiligreeCorner used CSS element rotations instead of native SVG group rotations. 3) TYPE_LABELS.science duplicated 'Technological Groups'.
bugs.fix: 1) Elevated header to full-width root in content column. 2) Replaced CSS rotations in VectorFiligreeCorner with native SVG rotate(angle 12 12), geometricPrecision, and Gaussian illumination aura. 3) Renamed TYPE_LABELS.science to 'Scientific Groups'.

bugs.error_message: Selected entity text rendered pitch black/illegible on dark sidebar in Royal Codex, and entity multi-select checkboxes rendered as generic modern slate wireframe squares out of theme
bugs.root_cause: 1) EntityItem applied customStyle with color: entity.documentColor || undefined. When an entity had documentColor set to #000000 (common default from Fantasia Archive imports) or dark hexes, the inline style overrode Tailwind's active text class (text-[#fff8e7]), rendering active entity text black on dark brown leather gradient. 2) Checkbox elements rendered raw Lucide <Square> and <CheckSquare> with hardcoded slate-400 styles, clashing with medieval illuminated manuscript, nautical, and scholastic themes.
bugs.fix: 1) In Sidebar.tsx, set customStyle.color to undefined whenever isActive is true so the theme's radiant active text color always rules, and added isColorLegibleOnDark / isColorLegibleOnLight luminance checks so dark document colors never override inactive item text on dark sidebars. 2) Created dedicated CodexCheckbox component adapted across all 4 themes (Royal Codex velvet/gold aura, Grand Voyager nautical teal, Wiki scholastic rubricated crimson, Sovereign amber/slate) and wired it into Sidebar, OptionsView, and TrashView.

bugs.error_message: Application displays only a blank/blue screen on launch or render crash without error details
bugs.root_cause:
The root in index.tsx was mounted directly without a top-level React ErrorBoundary or window error listeners. When any uncaught runtime exception occurred during mount/render, React unmounted the DOM tree inside
, leaving only the body background (#0f172a, slate blue) with zero visual feedback or diagnostics for the user.
bugs.fix: Wrapped root <App /> in an ErrorBoundary in src/index.tsx with custom fallback label, and added global window 'error' and 'unhandledrejection' listeners that render a visible diagnostic crash banner with full stack trace and a one-click reload button.

bugs.error_message: Top header realm navigation dropdowns (Chronicles, Cartography, The Web) clipped and rendered behind Tier 2 dossier tabs and manuscript page
bugs.root_cause: Tier 1 ribbon container had `overflow-x-auto`. Under CSS specification, setting overflow-x: auto forces overflow-y: auto, constraining the vertical box to the 40px ribbon height. Absolutely positioned dropdown children extending below were clipped inside the ribbon and painted under the DOM-following Tier 2 dossier bar.
bugs.fix: Replaced `overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar` with `relative z-20 overflow-visible` on Tier 1 container, set `relative z-10` on Tier 2 bar, elevated active dropdown trigger to `z-[9995]`, and added a full-screen backdrop to handle click-outside dismissal.

bugs.error_message: Viewer cards (Vital Records, Inventory & Conditions, Atlas Anchor Pin) bursting out past the right boundary of the manuscript page
bugs.root_cause: ViewerSectionCard lacked `w-full min-w-0 max-w-full` constraints. Simultaneously, EntityViewer triggered side-by-side `lg:flex-row` at 1024px while character/location grids enforced 2 columns at 640px (`sm:grid-cols-2 gap-x-12`). Accounting for the 256px sidebar and manuscript padding, the main column had only ~200px available, causing children to horizontally blowout past the vellum page border.
bugs.fix: Added `w-full min-w-0 max-w-full` to all ViewerSectionCard variants. Deferred EntityViewer aside column from `lg` to `xl` (1280px). Changed CharacterSpecificsViewer grids to `md:grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 lg:gap-x-10` and trimmed LocationSpecificsViewer padding.

bugs.error_message: Parchment cream theme not extending to bottom of the window when scrolling down long entries; content lands on dark outer leather
bugs.root_cause: Outer leather binding and inner vellum page divs both used `flex-1 min-h-full`. In CSS flexbox, flex-1 sets `flex-basis: 0%` which constrains the container to the initial viewport height in a scroll container. Content taller than the viewport overflowed into the dark leather background while the cream background stayed viewport-height.
bugs.fix: Replaced `flex-1` with `grow shrink-0` (`flex-grow: 1; flex-shrink: 0; flex-basis: auto`) on the body content wrapper, manuscript binding, and inner vellum page, allowing the parchment background to dynamically stretch to the full scrollable height.

bugs.error_message: Viewer action buttons (Export, Edit Scroll, Lock, Delete) rendered directly over entity title text on narrow viewports
bugs.root_cause: RoyalHeader, WikiHeader, and CodexHeader activated a side-by-side flex row at `md` (768px). With the 256px sidebar and manuscript padding subtracted, only ~450px of content width remained. The 5 action buttons require ~340px, squeezing the title to <120px and forcing title text to overflow horizontally under the action buttons.
bugs.fix: Switched header layout from `md:flex-row` to `lg:flex-row`, keeping title and action buttons cleanly stacked below 1024px. Removed rigid flex wrapping on `h1` and added `min-w-0 [overflow-wrap:anywhere] break-words`.

bugs.error_message: Attribute score badges (STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA) contour broken; bottom chevron slopes have no border lines with a disconnected 1px dot at the tip
bugs.root_cause: Badges relied on rectangular CSS `border` combined with `clipPath: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0 75%)`. CSS rectangular border only traces the outer rectangle. The polygon cuts across the middle of the box where no border exists, leaving the two angled bottom edges borderless.
bugs.fix: Replaced rectangular CSS borders with an inline SVG `<polygon>` with `vectorEffect='non-scaling-stroke'` and dual stroke overlays tracing all 5 edges of the shield perimeter seamlessly at any DPI scale.

bugs.error_message: WorldMap/Atlas view elements (pins, ley-lines, dossier, filters, HUDs) overlayed top toolbar (Jump, Scratchpad, Keybinds, Theme Picker) due to incorrect z-index hierarchy — map elements at z-50+ while toolbar at z-10
bugs.root_cause: App.tsx top toolbar used z-10. WorldMap pins used z-50 (zIndex: 60), dossier z-40, ley-lines z-10, filters z-40, HUDs z-30. ThemeSwitcher dropdown z-50. All WorldMap elements sat above the toolbar.
bugs.fix: Raised App.tsx top toolbar to z-[100] with data-interactive-ui=true. Restructured WorldMap z-index: ley-lines z-[15], pins z-[10]-z-[50] (hovered), dossier/filters/search z-[35], HUDs z-[25]. ThemeSwitcher dropdown raised to z-[110]. All verified with build/typecheck/tests.

bugs.error_message: Timeline events forced to minimum 2-year visual span; point-in-time events (battles, coronations) incorrectly rendered as long ribbons
bugs.root_cause: TimelineView rawItems extraction defaulted all events to `end = start + 3` years and enforced `Math.max(end, start + 2)` minimum span, regardless of whether event had endDate set. No distinction between point events (single date) and span events (start + end).
bugs.fix: Added `isPointEvent` field to ProcessedTimelineItem. Events with only startDate/date (no endDate) now render as diamond markers at exact year position. Span events with both startDate and endDate render as ribbons. Updated quick-create to only set startDate.

bugs.error_message: Annual Calendar View completely disconnected from events — shows months/festivals but zero event markers, no navigation to timeline
bugs.root_cause: AnnualCalendarView accepted only calendar prop. No events passed, no event rendering on day grid, no onEventClick/onDayClick callbacks. TimelineView rendered AnnualCalendarView without displayYear sync, events, or callbacks.
bugs.fix: Extended AnnualCalendarViewProps with events[], onEventClick, onDayClick. Added yearEvents memo to extract events for displayed year. Day grid now shows event dots with click-to-navigate. Added onDayClick for quick-create. TimelineView now passes displayYear (synced to camera), events, onEventClick=onNavigate, onDayClick=handleQuickCreateEventAtDate.

bugs.error_message: Timeline Chronos camera and Annual Calendar year not synchronized — clicking Annual tab shows Year 1 hardcoded, no sync with viewport position
bugs.root_cause: TimelineView rendered AnnualCalendarView with no displayYear prop (defaulted to 1). No onYearChange to jump timeline camera. No events passed for rendering.
bugs.fix: TimelineView now computes displayYear from viewport scroll position: `Math.round(minYear + ((viewport.scrollLeft + viewport.clientWidth / 2 - 24) / canvasWidth) * yearSpan)`. Passes onYearChange=handleJumpToYear to sync camera when user navigates years in Annual Calendar.

bugs.error_message: Backlinks for character-to-location, character-to-species, character-to-occupation, character-to-skill relationships silently return empty arrays
bugs.root_cause: backlinkUtils.ts references field names that don't exist on the actual entity types: `placeOfResidenceId` (actual: `pairedCurrentLocationNew`), `placeOfOriginId` (actual: `pairedOriginLocationNew`), `placeOfDemiseId` (actual: `pairedDemiseLocationNew`), `speciesIds` (actual: `pairedRace`), `occupationIds` (actual: `pairedProfession`), `skillIds` (actual: `pairedSkills`), etc. Also `parentsOfCharacter` / `childOfCharacter` were ignored.
bugs.fix: Updated backlinkUtils.ts to scan both modern `paired*` and relationship arrays as well as legacy fields. Also synced `allies` alias and group affiliations.

bugs.error_message: DashboardView creative insights re-randomize on every re-render, causing unstable/flickering text
bugs.root_cause: `insights` is computed inside a `useMemo` that depends on `world.entities` and `world.trash`, but calls `Math.random()` internally. Any state change that updates these (e.g., adding a tag) re-rolls all insight text. The memo does not capture a stable random seed.
bugs.fix: Added a `seed` state (integer), deterministic index math (`seed * prime + offset % len`), and a 'Consult the Oracle' reroll button that increments the seed manually.

bugs.error_message: NexusTreeView silently truncates family trees deeper than 5 levels with no user feedback
bugs.root_cause: TreeNode component has a guard `depth < 5` that stops rendering children beyond depth 5. No UI indicator was shown when truncation occurred.
bugs.fix: Added visual truncation indicator badge `+N descendants (depth limit)` when depth >= 5. Also updated root & child discovery to check bidirectional parent/child relations and fixed isDead check.

bugs.error_message: WorldMap location marker and connection creation uses window.prompt() — inaccessible and blocked in some browsers
bugs.root_cause: Adding a location marker calls `prompt('Location Anchor Name:')` and adding a connection calls `prompt('Connection Type (trade, magic, diplomatic, war):', 'trade')`. window.prompt() is synchronous, blocks the UI, is inaccessible to screen readers, and is suppressed in iframes/embedded environments.
bugs.fix: Replaced with state-driven React modals: `pendingMarkerPos` triggers anchor modal with text input; `pendingConnection` triggers ley-line type picker modal. Both route through `handleCreate` for schema defaults.

bugs.error_message: Timeline characters missing from view when dateOfBirth / dateOfDeath fields are empty strings
bugs.root_cause: TimelineView reads `char.dateOfBirth` and `char.dateOfDeath`, but the actual Character type uses `birthDate` and `deathDate`. Also Event type uses `startDate` / `endDate` instead of `date`.
bugs.fix: Updated TimelineView.tsx to read `char.birthDate || char.dateOfBirth`, `char.deathDate || char.dateOfDeath`, and `evt.startDate || evt.date`.

bugs.error_message: git push pending — local main is 1 commit ahead of origin/main
bugs.root_cause: Phase 0 cleanup commit (a42247f) was created locally but not pushed to GitHub. The remote repo is behind.
bugs.fix: Run `git push` from the project root to publish the Phase 0 cleanup commit.

bugs.error_message: WorldMap anchor placement does not allow selecting existing locations and permits duplicate identical-name entries
bugs.root_cause: Clicking the map in WorldMap only allowed typing a text name for a newly created location, with no option to choose an existing unanchored/anchored location, and no duplicate name validation.
bugs.fix: Added two-tab anchor modal ('Pin Existing Location' with search and relocation confirmation warning, and 'Create New Location' with live and submit-time case-insensitive duplicate checks across all entity types). Auto-incremented default entity names in store handleCreate.

Replaced opening

bugs.fix: Changed closing tag to on line 32.

bugs.error_message: Exporting lore as Markdown or HTML prompts where to save twice; saving only once fails
bugs.root_cause: Tauri desktop saveFileNative invoked plugin:dialog|save (dialog 1), but then attempted writing via plugin:fs commands which failed due to strict capability path scopes or IPC argument mismatches. Upon catch, it erroneously fell through to web fallback downloadBlobWeb, triggering window.showSaveFilePicker in WebView2 (dialog 2).
bugs.fix: Created native unrestricted write_file_to_disk and read_file_from_disk commands in src-tauri/src/lib.rs; updated nativeFileBridge.ts to use write_file_to_disk and ensure desktop mode never falls through to downloadBlobWeb.

bugs.error_message: Manage Eras and Add Milestone Pin buttons do nothing when clicked in TimelineView
bugs.root_cause: ManageErasModal and AddMilestoneModal both check `if (!isOpen) return null;` internally. In TimelineView.tsx, both modals were rendered conditionally with `{isOpen && <Modal .../>}` without passing the `isOpen` prop, leaving `isOpen` undefined inside the modal components, causing them to immediately render null.
bugs.fix: Passed `isOpen={isManageErasOpen}` and `isOpen={isAddMilestoneOpen}` along with exact matching props (`onSaveEras`, `onSaveMilestone`, `initialMilestone`, `existingEntities`) to both modals in TimelineView.tsx.

bugs.error_message: Groups & Affiliations cards horizontally overflow and overlap neighboring columns when window is small
bugs.root_cause: GroupRoleGroup container rendered with hardcoded lg:col-span-3 inside a sub-grid and lacked min-w-0 and proper 12-column span configuration, while SmartSelect defaulted to gridSpan=12 inside narrow sub-columns, blowing out the container width on compact viewports.
bugs.fix: Refactored GroupRoleGroup into a flex-col container with min-w-0 and gridSpan={12} on internal SmartSelect calls. Wrapped the 5 group cards in CharacterSpecifics and LocationSpecifics in a responsive 12-column grid (`grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4`). Added full theme support via useTheme().

bugs.error_message: Characters nested under another character in the sidebar tree do not reflect in Parents or Children fields on character pages
bugs.root_cause: Sidebar tree nesting writes to entity.parentId, whereas CharacterSpecifics and CharacterSpecificsViewer only read char.parentsOfCharacter / char.childOfCharacter. The two data representations were completely decoupled.
bugs.fix: Implemented dual-layer sync: (1) In CharacterSpecifics and CharacterSpecificsViewer, computed effectiveParentIds and effectiveChildIds via useMemo uniting parentId, parentsOfCharacter, and related entities. (2) In reorderAndReparentEntity (useWorldStore), automatically synchronize parentsOfCharacter and childOfCharacter when dragging characters. (3) Added entity.parentId check to backlinkUtils.ts.

bugs.error_message: Relational context note in SmartSelect chips prematurely truncated at 70px despite ample empty container space
bugs.root_cause: SmartSelect chip note trigger had a hardcoded max-w-[70px] class on the note text span, capping visible text to ~10 characters regardless of parent input width.
bugs.fix: Removed max-w-[70px], gave chip and button min-w-0 max-w-full and shrink-0 on the target entity name, allowing the note to expand fluidly and use all available width before truncating gracefully at container edge.

bugs.error_message: Backlink entity links (such as Dumbass Island under Place of Origin) are not clickable in Royal Codex theme despite being clickable in Sovereign and Wiki modes
bugs.root_cause: CharacterSpecificsViewer had a theme branch for Royal Codex that mapped entity IDs to static text strings (originNames, residenceNames, speciesNames, occupationNames) joined by commas and rendered them in a span without click handlers or onNavigate calls.
bugs.fix: Created renderEntityLinks helper rendering interactive buttons with deep crimson styling (text-[#70121e] hover:underline) calling onNavigate(id). Applied to Origin, Residence, Species, Occupation, and Demise in Royal Codex Vital Records. Also added Hierarchy click navigation in EntityViewer.
